title: Pals Rewards Insider and VIP: Earning and Keeping a Free Tier
content:
Loyalty desk guidance on how the free tiers of **Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus** are earned, kept and re-evaluated.

**Qualifying spend.** Free tiers are earned by qualifying spend: purchases that earned points, net of reversals. A year's qualifying spend is the qualifying spend of the membership's points-earning entries dated from 1 January to 31 December of that calendar year, less the qualifying spend of its points-reversal entries dated in the same year.

**Earning a tier.** A free tier counts as earned once the membership's qualifying spend in the current calendar year reaches that tier's qualifying spend threshold, and the membership keeps the tier through the end of the calendar year after the year of qualification (the tier's retention).

**Retired provision.** The provision under which a membership moved up to Pals Rewards Insider or Pals Rewards VIP within the tier's upgrade effective days (1 calendar day for Pals Rewards Insider and Pals Rewards VIP; 0 for Pals Rewards Member, Tailwise Plus Monthly, Tailwise Plus Annual and Tailwise Plus Premier Annual) is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for applying an earned tier.

**1 January re-evaluation.** On 1 January every free-tier membership is re-evaluated against the higher of its prior-year qualifying spend and its current-year qualifying spend. A free tier never moves down during the year.

**Paid tiers.** Paid tiers are not earned by spend.

**When a paid tier ends.** When a paid tier ends, lapses or is refunded, the membership takes the highest free tier its spend and retention support at that date, and the free tier's earn rate applies from that day.

### Desk examples (hypothetical figures)

| Situation | Reading |
|---|---|
| Current-year qualifying spend $310.00 on Pals Rewards Member | the Pals Rewards Insider threshold has been reached |
| Current-year earnings $800.00, reversals $90.00 | qualifying spend is $710.00, below the Pals Rewards VIP threshold |
| Pals Rewards VIP earned during one year | kept through 31 December of the following year |
| On 1 January: prior-year spend $760.00, current-year spend $0.00 | re-evaluated against $760.00, the higher of the two |
| A Tailwise Plus Annual term ends; the member's spend and retention support Pals Rewards Insider | the membership takes Pals Rewards Insider and the Insider earn rate applies from that day |

superseded_clauses: A membership moves up to Pals Rewards Insider or Pals Rewards VIP within tier_upgrade_effective_days
